name: ProfitWell
label: ProfitWell — ProfitWell Metrics API v2
description: Official ProfitWell Metrics API v2 (Paddle-owned). Docs: https://profitwellapiv2.docs.apiary.io/ — setup: https://www.paddle.com/help/profitwell-metrics/setup/get-started/profit-well-api. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. Trailing slashes required. Paddle Billing GET /metrics stays on the paddle node — do not fork. Auth is the raw private token (no Bearer).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for ProfitWell. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: metric_get | plan_list | transaction_list. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Body
schema.description: Request payload object for create/update-style calls when an operation accepts a JSON body. Example: {"email":"a@b.com"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: metric_get | plan_list | transaction_list. Default metric_get. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: ProfitWell credential (header Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Body
configurationParameters.description: Request payload object for create/update-style calls when an operation accepts a JSON body. Example: {"email":"a@b.com"}.
